d: Deep purple hair is styled in a side ponytail with long bangs and a stray cowlick, framing a youthful, adolescent face with a playful, winking expression and golden-amber eyes. A petite, slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved shirt under a maroon jumper dress with a pleated skirt, accented by a large teal bow at the neck and yellow straps on the back. A white ribbon with red edges ties the hair, while large, grey mechanical naval gun turrets are attached to the sides of the lower body.
